headline: Australian Cattle Prices Reach Records Following Widespread Rains
summary: Australian cattle prices set new records this week after substantial rainfall across Queensland and northern New South Wales prompted graziers to restock herds.
why: Australia is one of the world's leading beef exporters, and domestic livestock auction prices directly influence international beef supply chains.

impacts.name: Australian Agriculture
impacts.why: Record livestock prices improve farm-gate incomes across major eastern Australian grazing regions.
